scenario: Legacy header (no schemaVersion, no optional counts) re-sending a known sample UUID
notes: A pre-versioning client: the header carries neither schemaVersion nor clientVersion nor any count beyond deletionCount; absent counts are 0 and the version is 1. The first sample repeats the UUID stored by fixture 01 under a new batch ID, so it is a duplicate and a no-op (never an overwrite); the second is new. Applied to an empty store instead, the response would be accepted 2, duplicates 0.
